name: Minimal Creature Simple Template (CR -1 per Size Decrease)
body:
Minimals are small versions of normally Medium, Huge or Large sized animals and beasts. Any animal or generally animal-like beast (GM’s discretion) can become a minimal.

Dinosaurs and their ilk are most commonly found as minimals on isolated islands in the Mediterranean where entire miniature pre-historic eco-systems can be found.

Creatures with the minimal template are dwarf specimens of the base animal or magical beast. You can also use this simple template to easily create a smaller variant of a monster. This template cannot be applied to creatures that increase in power through aging or feeding (such as dragons or barghests) or creatures that are Fine-sized.

Rebuild Rules

Size decrease to Small; AC reduce natural armor by 2 per size change; Attacks decrease damage dice by 1 step per size change; Ability Scores –4 Strength, –2 Con, +2 Dex per size change.
